cheapest_two_nights.question: Which saved hotel is cheapest for two nights from October 11 to October 13, 2026?

proposal.sql: SELECT h.hotel_id, COALESCE(h.name, '(name not provided)') AS name, COUNT(*) AS nights_found, MIN(n.rooms_available) AS min_rooms, SUM(n.nightly_rate_cents) AS total_cents FROM saved_hotels h JOIN demo_hotel_nights n ON n.hotel_id = h.hotel_id WHERE n.stay_date >= '2026-10-11' AND n.stay_date < '2026-10-13' GROUP BY h.hotel_id HAVING COUNT(*) = 2 AND MIN(n.rooms_available) >= 1 ORDER BY total_cents LIMIT 50
proposal.reason: Hotels with a room free on both nights, cheapest total first.

cheapest_two_nights.answer: Quiet Test Lodge is the cheapest for October 11 to 13, 2026: $180.00 for 2 nights with at least 5 rooms free each night. Harbor Test Inn is $230.00 and Far Test Suites is $300.00. These rates and rooms are simulated classroom data.

proposal.reason: Hotels with a room on all three nights.

three_nights_missing_night.answer: Harbor Test Inn is the cheapest: $390.00 for the 12th, 13th and 14th. Far Test Suites is $450.00. Simulated classroom data.
